References 2, 3 and 4 establish the approved chunky matte Empire tactical adult sprite family. Muted dusty plum knee-length coat with broad turned cuffs and simple patch pockets, a deep charcoal scarf bunched around neck, brown trousers and enormous rounded brown boots on very short sturdy legs. Style: approved chunky matte hand-painted tactical sprite, huge head and hands, broad compressed torso, short sturdy legs and huge boots, bold near-black outline, clean broad low-saturation matte planes and only two or three broad shadows. Extremely readable at 44 logical pixels crown-to-sole. No photorealism, pores, grain, tiny scratches, fine fabric folds, tiny hair strands, dense facets, glossy highlights or fine noise.

Composition: SINGLE full body character on genuinely transparent RGBA background. Wide landscape canvas approximately 1585x992 matching approved references. Hair crown near y40, lowest boot sole near y970, crown-to-sole body about 930 native pixels; foot midpoint near x800. Broad transparent horizontal margins for entire book, pen and satchel. Keep every hair, hand, page, scroll and both boots inside canvas with transparent margins. This idle establishes fixed adult body scale for future poses.
No scenery, ground, floor shadow, base, ring, glow, haze, background colors, magenta, labels, text or additional objects. Hard clean silhouette with only narrow antialias edge; preserve true transparent alpha.
